description:
Add Target

Adds a target to a Load Balancer.

#### Operation specific errors

| Status | Code | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `422` | `ip_not_in_vswitch_subnet` | The IP you are trying to add does not belong to the vswitch subnet of the attached network |
| `422` | `ip_not_owned` | The IP you are trying to add as a target is not owned by the Project owner |
| `422` | `ip_not_assigned_to_server` | The specified IP is neither the Primary IPv4 address nor in the IPv6 subnet of the given Server |
| `422` | `load_balancer_public_interface_disabled` | The Load Balancer's public network interface is disabled |
| `422` | `load_balancer_not_attached_to_network` | The Load Balancer is not attached to a network |
| `422` | `network_has_no_vswitch_subnet` | The given IP is private but attached network does not have a vswitch subnet |
| `422` | `resolve_cloud_private_targets_error` | The server you are trying to add as a target is not attached to the same network as the Load Balancer |
| `422` | `resolve_cloud_public_targets_error` | The server that you are trying to add as a public target does not have a public IPv4 address |
| `422` | `target_already_defined` | The Load Balancer target you are trying to define is already defined |

allOf.description: Configuration of a Load Balancer target.

ip.description: Configuration for an IP target. It is only possible to use the (Public or vSwitch) IPs of Hetzner Online Root Servers belonging to the project owner. IPs belonging to other users are blocked. Additionally IPs belonging to services provided by Hetzner Cloud (Servers, Load Balancers, ...) are blocked as well. Only valid and required if type is `ip`.
IP of a server that belongs to the same customer (public IPv4/IPv6) or private IP in a subnet type vswitch.

ip.title: LoadBalancerTargetIP

label_selector.description: Configuration for label selector targets, only valid and required if type is `label_selector`.
label_selector.title: LoadBalancerTargetLabelSelector

server.description: Configuration for type Server, only valid and required if type is `server`.

ip.description:
Optional public IP of the Server to use as target.
Must be the Primary IPv4 of the Server, or an IPv6 host address within IPv6 /64 subnet of the Server. If omitted, the Primary IPv4 of the Server is used. Must not be a private IP and is only valid for public targets.

server.title: LoadBalancerTargetServer

allOf.title: LoadBalancerTarget

use_private_ip.description: Use the private network IP instead of the public IP of the Server, requires the Server and Load Balancer to be in the same network. Only valid for target types `server` and `label_selector`.

wait.description: Poll the resulting action until success/error or timeout.
